look_here_first: Look for the small spurred yellow flowers, then check for erect, often straight capsules and inconspicuous self-pollinating (cleistogamous) flower clusters. Measure mature seeds and inspect the margin; do not rely on raceme height or capsule length alone because subspecies vary.

key_traits.label: Habit
key_traits.text: Glaucous to green, branched winter annual, often 20–40 cm with multiple erect or ascending stems.

key_traits.label: Leaves
key_traits.text: Finely divided alternate leaves, ultimate lobes ovate to obovate, sometimes with minute abrupt tips.

key_traits.label: Flowers
key_traits.text: Bilateral yellow flowers in terminal and lateral racemes; four petals, one spurred; spurred outer petal usually 11–15 mm, spur 4–7 mm. Some racemes bear minute cleistogamous flowers.

key_traits.label: Fruits
key_traits.text: Mostly erect linear capsules, often about 10–35 mm across the species and subspecies; shiny seeds around 1.5 mm diameter lacking a marginal ring in the FNA treatment.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: Photograph the side-view flower and rearward spur

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: Check mature capsule angle and shape

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: Use seed margin and size under magnification; assess subspecies variability
